meta.defaultTitle: Ethos — Digital gifts that open like a story
meta.description: Create a personalised, animated digital gift for someone you love. Photos, their song, your words. Share with a link or QR code. Free to start.

hero.eyebrow: Digital gifts. Ten minutes to make, years to keep.
hero.sub: A personal, animated gift page with your photos, their song and your words. Sent as a link or a QR code, opened on their phone.
hero.videoAlt: The Bouquet template: flowers come together one by one, the paper folds round and a card drops in.
hero.caption: Bouquet, our newest template. The real thing, not a mockup.
hero.ctaNote: Free to start. No account until you publish.

templates.title: Every template is a whole experience.
templates.blurb: Not a card with a photo slot. Each one is a scene the recipient moves through: tapping, scrolling, holding, sometimes blowing out candles.
templates.moreBlurb: New templates land regularly. Everything buyers get every future one, forever.

reactions.title: The link goes out. The reply comes back.
reactions.blurb: At the end of every gift there is a reaction button: an emoji, a note, or a 20-second voice message, delivered straight to you.

cards.sent: I made you something. Open it with sound on.
cards.reply: I'm at work and crying in the stairwell. Three years. THREE.

cards.sent: Look up. Well, look at your phone.
cards.reply: You put the tent night in there. I found all six. Fourteen days.

cards.sent: Feliz día, ma. Tap the seal.
cards.reply: Quién te enseñó a hacer esto?? Lo vi cuatro veces ya.

reactions.placeholderNote: Sample reactions. Real ones replace these as they come in.

steps.title: Pick a template
steps.body: Try any of them full-screen first. Two are free; the rest unlock once and stay yours.

steps.title: Add your photos and words
steps.body: Drop in photos, pick their song, write what you'd never say out loud. The preview updates as you type.

steps.title: Share the link, or the card
steps.body: Send it on WhatsApp, iMessage, anywhere. Or print the QR card and hide it in a book.

occasions.title: For the day, or for no reason at all.
occasions.blurb: Templates are tagged by occasion, but nothing stops you sending a birthday sky in March.

final.title: Say the thing.
final.blurb: The people we love mostly hear us in passing. This is the other way: a small, deliberate thing they can open twice.

openings.title: Choose how it opens.
openings.blurb: The first thing they see is a cover with their name on it. Pick the one that feels like them; the gift is waiting underneath.

footer.blurb: Gifts that open like a story.

faq.a: No. Every price is a one-time payment. What you unlock stays on your account for as long as it exists.

faq.q: What does the free tier actually include?
faq.a: Two full templates (The Letter and Constellations), unlimited gifts, up to 10 photos per gift, our music library, a countdown and a hidden final surprise. Free gifts show a small “Made with Ethos” footer. Real songs, video clips and voice messages are premium extras.

faq.q: Can I try a template before paying?
faq.a: Every template has a full live demo, and the editor is free to use with a live preview. You only pay when you publish something that needs a premium feature.
No. Links are meant to be permanent. If we ever had to change that we'd give you at least 90 days' notice.

faq.q: Can I edit a gift after it's live?
faq.a: Yes. Edits go live at the same link the moment you save.
USD, EUR and GBP, with cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay via Stripe. Prices include VAT where it applies.

seo.templatesDescription: {count} animated digital gift templates, from a wax-sealed love letter to a bouquet that never wilts. Add your photos, a song and your words. Every one has a free live demo.
seo.occasionsDescription: Personal, animated digital gifts for birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine's Day, long-distance love, apologies and more. Photos, their song and your words, sent as a link or QR code.

birthday.title: Digital birthday gifts
birthday.description: Make a digital birthday gift they'll open again and again: your photos, their favourite song and your words, animated and sent as a link or QR code. Free to start.
birthday.intro: A birthday message that does more than sit in a chat. Blow out the candles in Birthday Cinema, crack open a Fortune Cookie or print a Front Page about them, with your photos and their song, and set it to open at midnight.

anniversary.title: Digital anniversary gifts
anniversary.description: An anniversary gift made from your own story: your photos, your song and a letter in your words, animated and sent as a link. Try every template free.
anniversary.intro: One year or twenty: tell the story of the two of you with the photos only you have, the song that's yours and a note that says what a card can't. Walk them down Our Timeline, hang your photos in a Museum or seal it all in The Letter.

valentines.title: Digital Valentine's Day gifts
valentines.description: A Valentine's gift that arrives in seconds and lasts for years: a wax-sealed love letter, a bouquet that never wilts or a sky full of your photos, with your song.
valentines.intro: Flowers wilt and chocolates don't last the evening. A love letter they open with a tap, a bouquet you picked stem by stem, or a night sky where every photo is a star will still be there next February.

wedding.title: Digital wedding gifts
wedding.description: A wedding gift for the couple or for each other: photos, your wishes and a song gathered in an animated gift to keep, shared with a link or a printed QR card.
wedding.intro: Collect the moments and the words that matter into something the couple can open the morning after, or give one to your partner before the ceremony. Print the QR card and tuck it inside a real one.

graduation.title: Digital graduation gifts
graduation.description: Celebrate a graduate with a digital gift: photos from every year, a message from you and a song that fits, sent as a link to open on the big day.
graduation.intro: From the first day to the cap and gown. Line up the photos, say what you're proud of, and time it to open the day they finish. Front Page puts them on the cover; Our Timeline draws the road that got them there.

christmas.title: Digital Christmas gifts
christmas.description: A Christmas gift that can't get lost in the post: an animated gift with your photos, a festive song and your message, timed to open on Christmas morning.
christmas.intro: For the people you won't see this year, and the ones you will: a gift that opens on Christmas morning wherever they are, with no shipping deadline to miss. Midnight Countdown ends in fireworks right on time.

mothers-day.title: Digital Mother's Day gifts
mothers-day.description: Tell your mum what she means to you with a digital Mother's Day gift: old photos, her favourite song and a letter in your words, sent as a link she can keep.
mothers-day.intro: Find the old photos, pick the song she always sings along to, and write the things that are hard to say out loud. Give her a Bouquet that never wilts, or a Jar of Reasons to shake one out whenever she likes.

fathers-day.title: Digital Father's Day gifts
fathers-day.description: A Father's Day gift he'll actually keep: photos through the years, a song he loves and a note from you, in an animated gift sent as a link.
fathers-day.intro: Skip another tie. Put the road trips, the lessons and the terrible jokes into a gift that opens on his phone: his own Front Page, or a Museum of the two of you.

apology.title: Digital apology gifts
apology.description: Say sorry properly: a heartfelt apology letter with your photos and a song, sent as a digital gift that shows you took the time. Free to start.
apology.intro: When a text isn't enough. Take the time to write what you mean, add the moments that matter, and send something they can open when they're ready. The Letter is free, and a Text Thread says it one bubble at a time.

long-distance.title: Long-distance relationship gifts
long-distance.description: Gifts for long-distance relationships that arrive the moment you send them: a passport that flies from your city to theirs, a sky of your photos, or a love letter with your song.
long-distance.intro: Miles apart, still close. Send something they can open the second it's ready, scheduled for their time zone, with the places and the songs that belong to you both.

halloween.title: Digital Halloween gifts
halloween.description: A Halloween gift they open with a tap: a doorbell, a jack-o'-lantern, a small ghost with your photos and your words, and a song in the dark. Free to start.
halloween.intro: Better than a bag of sweets. Ring the bell in Trick or Treat, light the pumpkin and let a small ghost hand over your photos, your message and your song. Or make it cozy instead: a candle, a blanket and a letter by the fire in Fireside.

just-because.title: Just because gifts
just-because.description: No occasion needed: a small digital gift with your photos, a song and a few honest words, to tell someone you're thinking of them.
just-because.intro: The best gifts don't wait for a date on the calendar. Make one in ten minutes and send it for no reason at all.
